items.markdown:
You can calculate your Customer Acquisition Cost using the [Omni Calculator CAC Tool](https://www.omnicalculator.com/finance/cac) by `dividing your total sales and marketing expenses by the number of new customers acquired`.[[1]](https://www.omnicalculator.com/finance/cac)[[2]](https://www.yotpo.com/tools/customer-acquisition-cost-cac-calculator/)

### The CAC Formula

CAC=Total Marketing Costs+Total Sales Costs Number of New Customers CAC equals the fraction with numerator Total Marketing Costs plus Total Sales Costs and denominator Number of New Customers end-fraction C A C=T o t a l M a r k e t i n g C o s t s+T o t a l S a l e s C o s t s N u m b e r o f N e w C u s t o m e r s  

### Steps to Calculate

- **Determine marketing costs:** Add up ads, content, tools, and marketing salaries for a set time period.[[1]](https://www.productlift.dev/cac-calculator/)
- **Determine sales costs:** Add up sales salaries, commissions, and CRM software for that same period.[[1]](https://www.productlift.dev/cac-calculator/)[[2]](https://aluslabs.com/tools/cac-calculator)
- **Count new customers:** Count only brand-new paying customers gained during that exact timeframe.[[1]](https://www.yotpo.com/tools/customer-acquisition-cost-cac-calculator/)[[2]](https://aluslabs.com/tools/cac-calculator)
- **Divide:** Sum your expenses and divide by your new customer count.[[1]](https://usedatalayer.com/tools/cac-calculator)
